# DevOps Engineer K8s

## Summary
We need experienced engineers to drive the development of our cloud infrastructure solutions from concept through deployment. The ideal candidate is passionate about automation frameworks like Kubernetes and capable of working collaboratively within an agile team environment. This role requires strong technical skills alongside excellent communication abilities.

## Required Skills
- Expert proficiency in Kubectl (Kubernetes)
- Experience using Git version control systems such as Github or Bitbucket
- Familiarity with Continuous Integration & Delivery tools including Jenkins and TeamCity
- Knowledge of Containerization technologies utilizing Docker
- Understanding of Infrastructure as Code concepts via Terraform
- Ability to configure and manage container orchestration platforms like kubeadm
- Proficiency with Source Control Management Systems like GitHub Actions
- Competency in implementing build pipelines leveraging CI/CD toolchains

## Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain complex software applications built on Kubernetes environments
- Collaborate closely with teams across Agile methodologies while adhering strictly to SDLC processes
- Utilize automated testing suites provided by CI/CD ecosystems during project execution
- Ensure all deployed services adhere accurately according to defined standards at every stage of lifecycle
- Participate actively in daily meetings involving cross-functional stakeholders
- Contribute regularly towards setting up new projects based upon organizational needs

judge.rationale: All requested areas (Kubernetes, CI/CD) are covered thoroughly. Structure is excellent, though some skill overlap exists.
